name: Grenada
description: Grenada, the spice island, from the Kalinago to French and British rule, independence in 1974, the revolution and the American invasion of 1983.

checkpoints.name: Spice colony
checkpoints.note: France settled the island in 1650 and Britain took it in 1763. Sugar and later nutmeg grew there.

checkpoints.name: Independent Grenada
checkpoints.note: Grenada became independent in 1974. Bishop's revolution of 1979 ended in his murder and an American invasion in 1983.
